attributes.name: nav call-to-action button treatment
attributes.definition: How a call-to-action item (e.g. phone number or action link) in the navigation is styled relative to ordinary nav links.

values.definition: CTA is a solid-filled button with rounded corners, distinct from plain nav links.
CTA is a solid-filled button with sharp corners.
CTA has a border but no fill.
CTA styled like ordinary nav links.
No distinct CTA in the nav.

attributes.name: nav call-to-action fill color
attributes.definition: Color family of the fill on the nav CTA button.

values.definition: Fill uses the site's generic accent/brand color.
Fill is black, white or gray.
Any other fill color or no fill.
